description: Allow the remote liveview UI (loaded over the tailnet from liveview.hawk.thundersparrow.top) to invoke the lvsync plugin's offline data-layer commands. In Tauri 2 a remote origin can reach ONLY ACL-permitted PLUGIN commands (app #[tauri::command]s are unreachable from remote — that's why this is a plugin, like haptics). Grants core:default for the IPC layer plus each lvsync:allow-* token. Result: reader content + navigation metadata resolve from the local content-addressed store and work fully offline.
